Section 2: Respiratory Red Flags and Medical Escalation
Red Flag Symptoms Requiring Immediate Medical Attention: - Difficulty
breathing, wheezing, or shortness of breath. - Persistent high fever
(>38.5°C or 101.3°F) lasting more than 3 days. - Chest pain or pressure
during breathing or coughing. - Coughing up blood or thick discolored
sputum. - Bluish lips or face (cyanosis).
Special Considerations: Children, elderly individuals, and adults with
asthma or COPD should seek early medical advice for respiratory symptoms.
